tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and recalled verified mechanism indicate sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation. Because the target forecast horizon is 20 and all five paid rows have H below 0.5, obtain the slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting and confirming the model.

considered_alternatives.option: author_and_confirm_python_model using the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five parameters of the sink-coupled dual-horizon law are not identifiable from short-horizon observations; the long forecast horizon makes this ambiguity consequential.
A slow-horizon discriminating observation directly tests the competing adaptation timescales at lower cost.
It is irrelevant to the current parameter-identifiability question.
Short-horizon rows alone cannot establish whether adaptation reverses at the target horizon.
